motifs.washi_noise: Use an SVG noise filter overlay with opacity 0.03 for a paper texture on the main background.

component_overrides.card: Remove default shadow. Use bg-card text-card-foreground. Add border-[0.5px] border-border. Use rounded-sm (4px) for sharp editorial feel. Add generous padding p-6.
component_overrides.button: Primary uses bg-primary text-primary-foreground hover:bg-primary/90. Radius rounded-sm. Accent CTA uses bg-accent text-accent-foreground. Secondary uses transparent bg with border-primary.
component_overrides.badge: Use font-mono text-[10px] uppercase tracking-widest. Remove pill rounding, use rounded-sm. Add border border-border.
component_overrides.input: border-border focus-visible:ring-1 focus-visible:ring-primary rounded-sm h-10 px-3 bg-transparent.
component_overrides.sidebar: bg-[#F5F4F1] border-r border-border. Active nav item: text-primary font-medium with a 2px vertical left border in accent color (#E03C31). Inactive items: text-muted-foreground hover:text-primary.
component_overrides.tabs: Override default pill/card tabs. Use editorial underline style: border-b border-border, active tab has border-b-2 border-primary text-primary font-medium, inactive has text-muted-foreground hover:text-primary. px-4 py-2.
component_overrides.table: Dense layout. Use font-mono for numbers/stats. border-b border-border on rows. hover:bg-muted/50.

page_layouts.Login: Split layout. Left: Clean login form, centered, minimal. Right: 'Manga panel' aesthetic – a collage or abstract ink brush image with halftone background pattern.
page_layouts.App_Shell: Sidebar on left (collapsible). Topbar with global search (kbd shortcut ⌘K visibly indicated), notifications bell, user menu. Content area with soft washi background (#F9F8F6).
page_layouts.Admin_Dashboard: Bento grid (Control Room mode). Strict borders (border-collapse). Role distribution chart (Recharts). Quick actions row. Task health table.
page_layouts.Mangaka_Dashboard: Split view: 2/3 main, 1/3 sidebar. Main: Active Series Pipeline (visual track), Recent Activity Timeline. Sidebar: Next Actions (Action Inbox), Ranking Snapshot.
page_layouts.My_Series: Grid view for series covers. Covers have a 1px inner border. Badges absolutely positioned over covers. Filters on top: Status, Genre, Search.
page_layouts.Create_Series_Wizard: 3-step stepper horizontally. Clean forms. Center aligned card with max-w-2xl.
page_layouts.Series_Detail: Large Serif H1 for Title. Metadata row below (font-mono). Editorial Tabs (Proposal, Production, Workspace, Manuscript). Content renders inside tab area.
page_layouts.Page_Workspace: Konva canvas takes up max height (vh-100 minus topbar). Left sidebar for Page tasks/regions. Right sidebar for AI Review & Comments. Canvas area bg is slightly darker (#EAE8E3) to frame the white page.
page_layouts.Assistant_Dashboard: Focus on Task List. List view with priority flags. Earnings points highlighted in a large Serif display stat.
page_layouts.Editor_Dashboard: Review queue centric. Wide tables. 'Manuscripts to review' with quick action 'Review' buttons.
page_layouts.Board_Dashboard: Voting queue. Series cards with large 'Approve' / 'Reject' / 'Needs Revision' actions. Ranking charts using Recharts.
page_layouts.Settings_Profile: Standard 2-column layout (sidebar nav + settings form). Clean, dense inputs.

image_urls.description: Abstract ink brush stroke for the login screen. Apply CSS filter: invert(1) or mix-blend-mode: multiply to integrate with light theme, serving as a sumi ink motif.

testing_attributes: All interactive elements (buttons, nav links, form inputs, tabs) MUST include a 'data-testid' attribute (e.g., 'data-testid="login-submit-button"').
instructions_to_main_agent: IMPORTANT: The project requires .js/.jsx files for React components, NOT .tsx. Generate standard ES6 React components.
Use Tailwind v4 syntax and patterns. Ensure all colors and radius tokens are mapped in the main CSS file using @theme inline or variables.
Apply the Washi Paper + Editorial Ink aesthetic as described in colors and motifs. AVOID generic SaaS purple/blue.
Ensure 'data-testid' attributes are added to all interactive elements for robust testing.
For Shadcn components, directly modify the generated files to match the `component_overrides` (e.g., sharp corners, no shadows, mono text for badges).
Use `lucide-react` for icons, keeping them minimal and avoiding emojis.
Incorporate the halftone pattern or ink brush motifs strategically, especially in empty states and the login page.
